tasks.behavior: Sequence alt/opt fragments: schema, validation, scene boxes, SVG/editor overlay, and an original fixture.
acceptance: Sequence documents can author alt and opt fragments covering message order ranges; other kinds reject fragments.
opt requires one operand and alt requires at least two non-overlapping operands whose orders exist.
Scene, SVG/PNG/HTML, and the editor overlay draw fragment boxes and operand labels without remapping messages.
FEATURES/skill/README state that alt/opt fragments are modeled in this checkout; npm 0.1.0 still does not validate them.
